title: GAME detection date and wording corrected from GAME's own email
what_changed: The record said the intrusion was detected on 9 November (per Escudo Digital) and called it a cyberattack in which bank details were not compromised. GAME's customer email, reproduced by Geeknetic and reported by Roams (19 November), says unauthorized access was detected during the week of 9 November, that certain data may have been compromised, that passwords were not, and that GAME does not store payment data. Title, summary, date_note and an occurred_at time no page stated were corrected or removed.
